selected_evidence.summary: The directories exist, fstab has exactly one bind entry, validation succeeded, and the live target maps to /srv/inventory.
The mount unit is active; source and target exposed identical data and matching device/inode identities.

Healthy baseline boot ID fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34 was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to eee0f872-f1d3-47b7-812c-079c16de2e53, and the active mount plus retained test data recovered.

commands.command:
set -u
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'user='; id
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
printf 'existing_mount='; findmnt -rn -T /mnt/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true
printf 'source_dir='; stat -c '%F %U:%G %a %n' /srv/inventory 2>&1 || true
printf 'target_dir='; stat -c '%F %U:%G %a %n' /mnt/inventory 2>&1 || true
printf 'fstab_matches:\n'; awk '$0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && ($1=="/srv/inventory" || $2=="/mnt/inventory") {print NR ":" $0}' /etc/fstab

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory
if ! awk '$0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && $1=="/srv/inventory" && $2=="/mnt/inventory" && $3=="none" && $4=="bind" {found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' '/srv/inventory /mnt/inventory none bind 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
printf 'directories:\n'
stat -c '%F %U:%G %a %n' /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory
printf 'fstab_entry:\n'
awk '$0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && $1=="/srv/inventory" && $2=="/mnt/inventory" {print NR ":" $0}' /etc/fstab
printf 'fstab_validation:\n'
findmnt --verify --verbose

commands.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' 'inventory-bind-persistence-proof-v1' > /srv/inventory/.bind-mount-persistence-proof
systemctl daemon-reload
mount /mnt/inventory
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'mount_unit='; systemctl is-active mnt-inventory.mount
printf 'exact_mount='; findmnt -rn -M /mnt/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
printf 'fstab_entry='; awk '$0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && $1=="/srv/inventory" && $2=="/mnt/inventory" {print $0}' /etc/fstab
cmp -s /srv/inventory/.bind-mount-persistence-proof /mnt/inventory/.bind-mount-persistence-proof
printf 'data_match=yes\n'
printf 'source_inode='; stat -c '%d:%i %s %n' /srv/inventory/.bind-mount-persistence-proof
printf 'target_inode='; stat -c '%d:%i %s %n' /mnt/inventory/.bind-mount-persistence-proof
printf 'data_sha256='; sha256sum /mnt/inventory/.bind-mount-persistence-proof | awk '{print $1}'
